name: plot_expression_heatmap
description: Plot a gene expression heatmap (genes × samples) using seaborn. Shows the top N most variable genes with z-score normalization. Useful for visualizing RNA-seq or microarray expression patterns.

parameters.expression_path: string — path to expression CSV (genes as rows, samples as columns)
parameters.top_n: int — number of most variable genes to show (default 50)
